sources.title: PETSc KSP manual
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: SLEPc：特徵對殘差與後向誤差資格
related.titleEn: SLEPc: eigenpair residuals and backward-error qualification
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：問題定義、規範與求解狀態三者分欄驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Review problem definition, gauge and solver status in separate acceptance fields.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「SLEPc：特徵對殘差與後向誤差資格」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付矩陣向量乘法帳本、殘差向量、規範化檢查與特徵對驗收表。
related.differenceEn: Investigate SLEPc: eigenpair residuals and backward-error qualification using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver matrix-vector arithmetic, residual vectors, normalization checks and an eigenpair acceptance table distinguishing backward error from spectral conditioning and forward error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: b=[2,0] 的平均為一，移除 [1,1] 得 [1,−1]；算移除向量範數並保留原資料。
計算 Ax=[1.2,4] 與 λx=[2.4,3.2]，再由差向量求規範化誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Find mean one for b=[2,0], remove [1,1] and obtain [1,-1]. Compute the removed-vector norm while retaining the original load, making the mathematical modification visible rather than overwriting its provenance.

Compute Ax=[1.2,4] and lambda*x=[2.4,3.2], then form the difference. Retain both components rather than reducing early to a scalar, allowing a reviewer to identify which direction dominates the defect.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CWL：scatter 組合、輸出形狀與樣本身分
related.titleEn: CWL: scatter combinations, output shapes and sample identity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：問題定義、規範與求解狀態三者分欄驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Review problem definition, gauge and solver status in separate acceptance fields.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「CWL：scatter 組合、輸出形狀與樣本身分」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付參數 tuple 清單、flat/nested 形狀圖、唯一性檢查與聚合契約。
related.differenceEn: Investigate CWL: scatter combinations, output shapes and sample identity using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver parameter tuples, flat-versus-nested shape diagrams, uniqueness checks and an aggregation contract preserving sample identities independently of task completion order.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: b=[2,0] 的平均為一，移除 [1,1] 得 [1,−1]；算移除向量範數並保留原資料。
逐材料列四溫度，給每個 tuple 穩定識別碼；獨立以集合大小檢查重複與缺漏。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Find mean one for b=[2,0], remove [1,1] and obtain [1,-1]. Compute the removed-vector norm while retaining the original load, making the mathematical modification visible rather than overwriting its provenance.

List four temperatures under each material and assign a stable identifier to each tuple. Independently inspect set cardinality and membership, ensuring duplicated labels cannot make an incomplete set appear to contain twelve valid cases.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
